issues.legal_issue: Consent from co-owners or co-lessees is required when land offered for an LPG distributorship is jointly owned or jointly leased, but not when it is owned by one lessor and leased solely to the applicant.
An applicant is not disqualified where another applicant offers a separate parcel of land leased from the same lessor, even if both parcels lie within a larger contiguous holding.
The Corporation may accept alternate land offered at the letter-of-intent stage when the applicable guidelines permit it and the alternate land meets the advertisement’s requirements.
